# Change log

Every change to a design document (`docs/sad.md`, `docs/req.md`, `docs/ux.md`, `docs/lld/`, `docs/flows/`) and to the registers, by date, oldest first. One bullet per change: the IDs in bold, what changed, who decided, the files touched. The design documents themselves describe only the present. Entry format: the `spec-authoring` skill, Section 4.
